subject: Consolidated SSO/SCIM snapshots + RBAC ownership inventory request (SIG intake)
messages:
From: Greenline Security <security@greenline.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Jae Kim <j.kim@secureassure.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG - request for SSO/SCIM/RBAC artifacts

Hi Neha + Laura,

Following up on our SIG intake call earlier this week — SecureAssure is collecting a consolidated bundle of artifacts to complete the "Access Control" section. Can you provide the following by EOD 2026-12-21? Our ask is intentionally narrow to speed review.

Requested artifacts (high level):
- Representative SAML assertion samples for login flows (including NameID, attributes, audience) — 3 different user types
- SCIM delta logs or audit events covering the last 30 days (creates/updates/deletes)
- RBAC ownership snapshot (mapping of roles -> owners and role descriptions)
- Service account list + intended purpose and any ACLs (separate from human user SSO)
- Notes about any delegated admin or privileged role separation controls

If you have packaged these in a ZIP or a shared bucket, please include access link and any short instructions for redaction. If you need an extension, let me know — the q is time-sensitive because it feeds our SIG spreadsheet.

Thanks — Jae (on behalf of SecureAssure)

--
Jae Kim
Senior Auditor, SecureAssure
j.kim@secureassure.com

Thanks Jae — we can provide the requested items. Quick plan:

1) I will compile SAML assertion samples (anonymized) and a short CSV listing which user-type each sample represents.
2) Sean will export the SCIM delta events for the last 30 days and produce a JSONL export.
3) Laura will produce the RBAC ownership snapshot and the service-account mapping.

We have some artifacts in two places (internal secure bucket + GDrive). I will drop a ZIP in a pre-shared GDrive folder and send access. Expect the first delivery (SAML samples + RBAC snapshot) by EOD 2026-12-18 PST and the SCIM delta by EOD 2026-12-20 PST.

Attachments (stubs):
- [Attachment: sso_saml_assertion_samples_202611.csv (text)]
- [Attachment: rbac_owner_snapshot_20261217.csv (csv)]

If SecureAssure needs raw assertion XML rather than CSV samples, tell me which format and we'll include one XML sample per user type.

-Neha

Subject: Re: SIG - request for SSO/SCIM/RBAC artifacts

Neha — thanks for the plan. Two clarifications before you package:

- For SAML assertions, we need both the decoded attribute set and one raw assertion (base64) for each sample — that helps us validate attribute mapping.
- SCIM delta: please include the timestamp/actor for each change and indicate whether deltas are full or partial syncs. If export size is large, a gzipped JSONL is fine.

Also: please confirm whether service accounts are created via SCIM or managed outside (API-only). If outside, provide the provisioning owner and the onboarding playbook reference.

We appreciate the quick turnaround.

-Jae
